dict_not_found: Not in the 1828 dictionary — likely a proper name.
dict_note: Tap any word in an English translation to see what it meant in the era of the classic Bibles — Noah Webster's American Dictionary of the English Language, 1828.
plan_chrono_desc: The Bible in the order events happened: Job beside Genesis, Psalms with David, prophets with the Kings, epistles along Acts
plan_gospels_desc: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John in one month
plan_nt90_desc: All 260 New Testament chapters in 3 months
plan_proverbs_desc: One chapter of Proverbs a day for 31 days
plan_psalms_desc: Two Psalms a day through the whole Psalter
plan_year_desc: The whole Bible in 365 days, 3–4 chapters a day
tts_unavailable: Speech engine unavailable for this language
w_a2hs_2: Share, then «Add to Home Screen». It then opens full screen, like an app.
w_android_hint: Hexapla is also an Android app: free, offline, with audio.
w_android_note: Free and offline. Google Play, RuStore or a direct APK.
w_auto_next_note: When a chapter ends, go on to the next one.
w_backup_export_note: Bookmarks, highlights and notes as hexapla-backup.json — the Android app restores it too.
w_backup_import_note: From this app or the Android app. Adds to what is here; nothing is lost.
w_bed_note: Music or a fireside underneath the narration.
w_cjk_notice: Chinese and Japanese search matches character variants using Unihan (Unicode License v3) and OpenCC (Apache-2.0):
w_copy_blocked: Copying is blocked in this browser
w_dict_failed: The dictionary could not be loaded.
w_free: Hexapla is free and collects no data.
w_gap_other: %1$s has no verse here. %2$s reads it alongside.
w_keep_failed: Could not save %1$s (%2$s). Check the connection and try again; what was saved stays.
w_keep_offline_note: Chapters you open are saved as you read. Keep a whole translation to read any of it without a connection.
w_marks_none: None yet. Tap a verse to mark it.
w_no_bookmarks: No bookmarks yet. Tap a verse, then Bookmark.
w_no_highlights: No highlights yet. Tap a verse, then a colour.
w_no_notes: No notes yet. Tap a verse, then Note.
w_no_opus: This browser cannot play the generated narration (Ogg Opus). The King James Version's LibriVox readings still play.
w_no_recording: There is no recording of %1$s in this translation yet.
w_not_backup: That file is not a Hexapla backup
w_not_kept: Not kept: this browser is not saving site data
w_not_stored: This browser is not keeping site data, so marks last only until the page closes. Save a backup to keep them.
w_note_hint: Kept in this browser only. The note stays with the verse in every translation.
w_offline_hint: Chapters you open are saved on this device as you read. Keep a whole translation to read any of it without a connection.
w_parallel_hint: Up to six translations at once, verse by verse. %1$s leads; the others follow in this order.
w_popout_title: Keep the player on top of other windows
w_preview: In the beginning was the Word.
w_rec_failed: The recording could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
w_rec_opus: This browser cannot play these recordings (Ogg Opus audio). Try a current Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
w_safari_hint: In Safari on iPhone and iPad, saved data may be deleted after seven days without a visit. Adding Hexapla to the Home Screen avoids that limit.
w_search_about: Finds a phrase in %1$s, then verses with every word in any order. Searching all translations at once is not on the web yet (it would download about 200 MB).
w_search_cap: The first %1$d verses. Add a word to narrow it.
w_split_note: Translations side by side, verse by verse
w_strongs_failed: Strong's numbers could not be loaded
w_strongs_note: Tap a number for the Hebrew or Greek word and its definition.
w_strongs_off: Shown when the King James Version is the main translation.
w_uniform_note: One calm track after another, instead of music matched to the passage.
w_xref_source: The most-voted references at openbible.info (CC BY).
